title: Geolocation capture and display for service reports (frontend)

requirements.summary: Capture the user’s current geolocation on ReportEntryPage and submit it with the report when available, without blocking submission on errors/denial.
acceptanceCriteria: ReportEntryPage includes a clearly labeled geolocation section (e.g., “Location”) with a control to capture/refresh location and an indicator showing whether location is attached to the report.

If the user denies permission, location is unavailable, or the request times out, the report can still be submitted successfully without location and the UI shows a clear, non-blocking error message in English.
When location capture succeeds, the submitted report includes the captured latitude/longitude (and any additional captured fields) sent to the backend via useCreateReport.
No changes are made to frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

file_operations.description: Create a small reusable geolocation helper hook that wraps the browser geolocation API (one-shot capture only), supports a configurable timeout, returns status (idle/loading/success/error), and provides a user-friendly English error string suitable for non-blocking UI display.

Update frontend TypeScript types to reflect the new optional geolocation payload shape returned/accepted by the backend: keep latitude/longitude and add optional fields such as accuracy and captured timestamp if supported. Ensure DailyServiceReport.geolocation remains optional so reports can be submitted without location.

Add a “Location” section to the report submission form using existing shadcn/ui components already used on the page (e.g., Card/Alert/Button) (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.). Provide a Capture/Refresh control, show whether location is currently attached, show a non-blocking English error message on denial/unavailable/timeout, and include the captured geolocation object in the DailyServiceReport payload passed to useCreateReport when available.

requirements.summary: Show captured geolocation on report detail views and include geolocation fields in CSV exports while keeping browsing/filtering stable.
acceptanceCriteria: ReportDetailPage displays location information when present (e.g., latitude/longitude and accuracy if available) and hides the section when not present.
CSV download (frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts) includes additional column(s) for geolocation, leaving values blank when a report has no location.
Existing report history browsing and filtering continues to work without runtime errors after the DailyServiceReport type changes.

file_operations.description: Add a conditional “Location” section that renders only when report.geolocation is present, displaying latitude/longitude and any additional optional fields (e.g., accuracy, captured timestamp) when available. Use existing shadcn/ui building blocks already present on the page (e.g., Card/Separator/Badge/Alert) (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.).

Extend CSV export headers and row generation to include geolocation columns (e.g., Latitude, Longitude, Accuracy, Captured At). Leave fields blank when geolocation is missing and ensure CSV escaping remains correct.
